title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Research task completed successfully. Analysis of 120-day daily panel linking PM2.5 to respiratory clinic visits. Key findings: PM2.5 significantly predicts respiratory visits (β=0.43, p=0.036) controlling for heating degree days, flu index, and school holidays. Model R²=0.37. All deliverables complete: code/analysis.py, 7 figures in report/images/, intermediate outputs, and comprehensive report/report.md with methodology, results, and policy discussion.
